annotation.authors_or_issuer: Nepelski, D.; Sobolewski, M. (European Commission Joint Research Centre, AI Watch)
key_provisions_or_claims: AI investments in Europe in 2018 estimated at EUR 7.0-8.4 billion, 35-42% of the annual target in the Coordinated Plan.
Spending equals EUR 16.3 per capita or 0.04% of EU GDP.
AI treated as a general purpose technology, so complementary assets (skills, data, organisational capital) count as investment.
Investments grouped into three targets: talent and skills, lab to market, data and infrastructure.
Public sector accounts for roughly 30% of AI-related capital formation and labour compensation.
annotation.summary_en: JRC technical report under AI Watch presenting a methodology to estimate AI investments in Europe, treating AI as a general purpose technology. It estimates 2018 EU AI investment at EUR 7.0-8.4 billion, below the Coordinated Plan target, with country breakdowns including Poland. It is an economic measurement study with no robotics content.
annotation.title_clean: Estimating investments in General Purpose Technologies: The case of AI Investments in Europe
annotation.title_en: Estimating investments in General Purpose Technologies: The case of AI Investments in Europe
